title: Google Removed Part of Its AI's Brain
description:
Google just released a major Gemma 4 update.

The new Gemma 4 12B model can understand text, images, and audio through a single unified architecture, while running efficiently on consumer hardware.

Google also introduced faster inference, improved reasoning, and new optimizations that make powerful AI more accessible than ever.
